tour.title: Project Architecture & Mission Overview
tour.description: Welcome to AstroVerse AI. Explore the project architectural guidelines, product specifications, and unified system topology.

tour.title: AstroVerse Frontend & 3D Celestial Canvas
tour.description: The responsive single-page application featuring the 3D celestial canvas, 100% stationary Vedic Panchang calendar grid, and day inspector.

tour.title: Swiss Ephemeris & Jyotish Kundli Engine
tour.description: High-precision sidereal calculations using Swiss Ephemeris for Lahiri ayanamsha, planetary longitudes, 5 Angas, and Vimshottari Dasha.

tour.title: Wallet Service Gateway & Cashfree Integration
tour.description: Unified billing and wallet gateway powering secure recharges, order creation, and native Supabase user sessions.

tour.title: Reverse Engineering Providers & Core CLI
tour.description: Modular analysis provider contracts integrating Ghidra, IDA Pro, Hopper, and Cutter with the REA command-line engine.

tour.title: Automated E2E Verification & Forensic Suites
tour.description: Playwright and Vitest regression suites ensuring zero visual defects, correct astronomical calculations, and API integrity.
